## About
Crimson Wheel Repair handles wheel refinishing from minor repair to full restoration. We fix bends, cracks, curb rash and machined (CNC) wheels, and we work on almost any wheel no matter the shape, size or manufacturer.
Everything happens in our shop at 13 New Brooklyn Rd in Edison. Our powder coating is done in-house, and we don't send any of our work out.
Customers know the owner, John, by name, and the shop holds a 4.8 rating from 484 Google reviews. If your steering wheel is shaking or your rims look rough, give us a call.

## Services
- Wheel straightening: Aluminum alloy wheels can bend after a hard pothole hit. Signs include vibration in the steering wheel or the car, or a wheel that keeps losing air. We straighten aluminum wheels from 15 to 24 inches to within the manufacturer's specifications.
- CNC wheel lathe: Our CNC wheel lathe brings damaged machined wheels back to a showroom-like finish.
- Strip and blast: When regular repair won't work, we strip the wheel to bare aluminum alloy and build it back up in the color or finish you choose. We can strip other metal parts too, so call and ask.
- Powder coating: A durable finish done in-house, in a range of colors and finishes.
- Wheel balance: After straightening, we balance your wheel on a modern balancer for a smoother ride. We also balance wheels on their own.
- Cosmetic repair: Painted or machined wheels that are curbed, gouged, discolored, aged or even missing a small section.

## FAQ
Q: What kind of wheel damage can you fix?
A: Bends, cracks and curb rash, plus machined (CNC) wheels. We repair almost any wheel regardless of shape, size or manufacturer.

Q: Can I choose my powder coat color?
A: Powder coating comes in a range of colors and finishes. Call us to check whether we offer the one you have in mind.
